name: Bloodscalp Ears
summary: Kebok in Booty Bay is losing guards and agents to jungle clashes with the Bloodscalp tribe. Worried about climbing expenses and answering to Baron Revilgaz, he offers coin to any adventurer willing to hunt down the trolls and return with proof of the kill.

sections.title: Mounting Costs
sections.body: In the bustling port of Booty Bay, Kebok faces a serious operational dilemma. The local trolls in Stranglethorn Vale have been killing his agents in the jungle, and he has lost many of his best guards in skirmishes with them. With the casualties mounting, so too are the costs, leaving him frantic over how to explain them to Baron Revilgaz.

sections.title: A Bounded Bounty
sections.body: Rather than allowing the losses to accumulate further, Kebok turns to outside help. He offers monetary compensation to travelers who head into the jungle, cull the Bloodscalp trolls, and bring back fifteen of their severed ears as undeniable confirmation of their demise.

faq.answer: Kebok is a goblin in Booty Bay who has agents and guards out in the jungle, and he has to answer to Baron Revilgaz for what they cost.

faq.q: Why does Kebok want Bloodscalp ears?
faq.answer: Bloodscalp trolls have been killing his agents in the jungle and costing him many of his best guards in skirmishes. The costs are piling up and he has no good way to explain them to Baron Revilgaz.
Kebok requires fifteen Bloodscalp ears before he will hand over your payment.

faq.q: Where does this bounty lead next?
faq.answer: Once Kebok compensates you for the Bloodscalp ears, he shifts his attention to another local threat in Skullsplitter Tusks.
